_comment: Keycloak partial-import for the Microsoft identity provider used by the Collab SharePoint connector. Import into the hub's realm (Realm settings -> Action -> Partial import, or kcadm). Fill in the two REPLACE_ id values from the Entra app registration; inject clientSecret from your secret store rather than committing it. Alias MUST match the hub's brokerTokenUrl (which ends in /broker/microsoft/token): the hub derives the alias the desktop links from that URL. tenantId is required because the Entra app is single-tenant (Keycloak >= 23 exposes it on the built-in Microsoft provider). See docs/sharepoint-connector.md.

config.defaultScope: openid profile email offline_access User.Read Sites.Read.All Files.Read.All
